summary.en: U.S. stocks fell sharply amid escalating Middle East tensions, with oil prices surging toward $100/barrel following attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and Iranian tanker by Houthi rebels. The Dow Jones slid ~550 points while inflation concerns pushed Treasury yields higher.
summary.zh: 美国股市大幅下跌，中东紧张局势升级。油价受也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施及伊朗油轮事件影响飙升至 100 美元/桶附近。道琼斯指数下跌约 550 点，通胀担忧推动美债收益率上升。

title.en: Oil Nears $100/barrel as Middle East Conflict Intensifies with Houthi Attacks on Saudi Facilities
title.zh: 油价接近 100 美元/桶，中东冲突因胡塞武装袭击沙特设施而升级

impact.en: Geopolitical supply shock driving energy prices to inflation-sensitive thresholds. WTI oil approaching key $100 resistance triggers rate hike fears, weighing on growth stocks.
impact.zh: 地缘政治供应冲击将能源价格推向通胀敏感阈值。WTI 原油接近关键阻力位$100，引发加息担忧，拖累成长股。

macroRisk.en: YES - Oil at $98-100 triggers persistent inflation expectations, pushing 10Y Treasury yields above 4.5%. Risk-on capital flows to defensive sectors.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 油价 98-100 美元触发持续的通胀预期，推动 10 年期美债收益率高于 4.5%。风险偏好资金流向防御性板块。

title.en: Dow Falls ~600 Points in Holiday-Shortened Session as US-Iran Tensions Rise
title.zh: 道指在节日缩短的交易时段下跌约 600 点，美伊紧张局势升级

impact.en: Market sentiment deteriorated significantly on geopolitical risks. Risk-off rotation favored defensive stocks over cyclicals as rate hike odds jumped to ~60%.
impact.zh: 市场因地缘政治风险情绪显著恶化。避险旋转偏好防御股而非周期股，加息概率跳升至约 60%。

macroRisk.en: YES - Market risk premium elevated by conflict escalation. VIX implied volatility expanding, broad-based weakness across growth names.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 冲突升级推高市场风险溢价。VIX 隐含波动率扩大，成长股普遍走弱。

title.en: Intel Surges 9% Despite Broader Tech Weakness, Chip Sector Defies Market Trend
title.zh: 英特尔逆势上涨 9%，芯片板块违背大盘趋势

impact.en: Intel military/defense contracting with US and its strategic positioning in advanced chips provide resilience. Sector divergence highlights defense-tech overlap importance.
impact.zh: 英特尔在国防合同及先进芯片战略布局提供韧性。板块分化突显防务科技重叠领域重要性。

macroRisk.en: NO - Intel defense contracts insulated it from geopolitical oil risk. Standout performer in a broadly negative environment.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 英特尔国防合同使其免受地缘政治油价风险影响。在普遍负面环境中表现突出。

title.en: Treasury Yields Jump as Inflation Recession Fears Resurface from Middle East Oil Shock
title.zh: 美债收益率跳升，中东油价冲击引发通胀衰退担忧重燃

impact.en: 10Y Treasury yield moved above 4.5% amid oil price shock. Bond market priced higher-for-longer Fed policy given supply-driven inflation risks.
impact.zh: 油价冲击下 10 年期美债收益率突破 4.5%。债券市场因供给驱动通胀风险定价更高更长的美联储政策。

macroRisk.en: YES - Yields rise compresses equities duration. Risk-sensitive portfolios rotate to short-duration bonds and high-dividend stocks.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 收益率上升压缩股票久期。风险敏感组合转向短久期债券和高股息股。

title.en: Brent Crude Approaches $100/barrel as War Risk Premium Enters Oil Markets
title.zh: 布伦特原油接近 100 美元/桶，油价市场计入战争风险溢价

impact.en: OPEC+ likely to defend production amid supply disruption fears. Energy sector outperforming as geopolitical premium sustains above $95 levels.
impact.zh: OPEC+可能在供应中断担忧下维持产量。能源板块因地缘政治溢价维持 95 美元以上水平而表现优于大盘。

macroRisk.en: YES - Energy inflation feedthrough to CPI raises Fed policy uncertainty. Real assets oil/gas stocks outperform bonds.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 能源通胀传导至 CPI 提升美联储政策不确定性。实物资产油气股表现优于债券。

ai.en: AI sector broadly negative as tech giants drag down broader market. Concerns over rate sensitivity and geopolitical tech supply chain disruptions offset AI earnings optimism.
ai.zh: AI 板块整体负面，科技巨头拖累大盘。利率敏感性和地缘政治技术供应链中断担忧抵消 AI 盈利乐观情绪。

semiconductor.en: Semis diverged: Intel +9% on defense contracts, NVIDIA/AMD mixed. Defense computing demand provides sector hedge against oil risk.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体分化：英特尔因国防合同上涨 9%，NVIDIA/AMD 表现不一。国防计算需求为抵御油价风险提供板块对冲。

bigTech.en: Big Tech AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL declined with broader market. Geopolitical risks to China/AI supply chains and cloud spending slowdowns create headwinds.
bigTech.zh: 大科技股随大盘下跌。地缘政治对中国/AI 供应链及云服务支出放缓构成逆风。

energy.en: Energy sector leading rally as oil nears $100. XLE ETF up significantly, with producers like OXY, CVX, COP benefiting from geopolitical supply shock.
energy.zh: 能源板块领涨，油价接近 100 美元。XLE ETF 显著上涨，OXY、CVX、COP 等生产商受益于地缘政治供应冲击。

ev.en: EV sector faces headwinds as higher oil prices reduce demand for alternative fuel vehicles. Range anxiety less relevant when gas costs rise significantly.
ev.zh: 电动车面临逆风，油价上涨降低替代燃料车辆需求。当汽油成本显著上升时，里程焦虑变得不那么相关。

market.en: Broad market weakness amid geopolitical escalation. S&P 500 down ~0.6%, Nasdaq -0.7%, Dow -0.9%. Breadth deterioration with defensive rotation ongoing.
market.zh: 地缘政治升级下大盘走弱。标普 500 下跌约 0.6%，纳斯达克-0.7%，道指-0.9%。广度恶化，防御股轮换持续。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver benefiting from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical uncertainty. XAU rising on risk-off sentiment and real rate decline.
preciousMetals.zh: 金银受益于地缘政治不确定性下的避险资金流入。XAU 因避险情绪和实际利率下降而上涨。

oil.en: WTI crude at $98-100, Brent near $100 as Houthi attacks and Iran conflict escalate. OPEC+ supply discipline likely to support prices despite global demand slowdown.
oil.zh: WTI 原油在$98-100，布伦特接近$100，也门和伊朗冲突升级。尽管全球需求放缓，OPEC+ 供应纪律可能支持油价。

futures.en: Nasdaq futures down ~0.6%, S&P 500 futures -0.5%, Dow -0.9% heading into US open after overnight Asia/Europe losses.
futures.zh: 纳斯达克期货下跌约 0.6%，标普 500 期货-0.5%，道指-0.9%，亚洲欧洲盘后美股开盘前。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield at 4.55% after oil shock, up from ~4.3% earlier. Fed rate hike odds now ~60% as inflation fears persist.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期美债收益率在油价冲击后为 4.55%，较早前的约 4.3% 上升。通胀担忧持续，美联储加息概率升至约 60%。

dxy.en: DXY slightly elevated around 97.5-98 as oil and geopolitical risks weaken EM currencies, supporting dollar strength.
dxy.zh: 美元指数因油价和地缘政治风险削弱新兴市场货币，支撑美元走强而略高于 97.5-98。

oil.en: WTI crude $98.50-100, Brent $102+ with war risk premium adding to baseline levels from supply disruptions.
oil.zh: WTI 原油$98.50-100，布伦特$102+，战争风险溢价因供应中断添加到基准水平。

keyRisk.en: Ongoing Middle East military escalation could push oil above $100 sustainably, locking in higher inflation expectations and forcing Fed into hawkish positioning.
keyRisk.zh: 中东军事升级持续，可能将油价推高至$100 以上并维持，锁定更高的通胀预期，迫使美联储采取鹰派立场。

note.en: Risk-off rotation driven by Middle East geopolitical escalation. Oil supply shock creates inflation uncertainty, pushing Treasury yields higher and compressing equity valuations.
note.zh: 避险轮换由中东地缘政治升级驱动。油价供应冲击造成通胀不确定性，推动美债收益率上升并压缩股票估值。

disclaimer.en: YUCLAW signals are research classifications, NOT investment recommendations. Past performance is no guarantee of future results.
disclaimer.zh: YUCLAW 信号是研究分类，非投资建议。过去表现不保证未来结果。
